mapper.select: WITH current_guardian AS ( SELECT id FROM consent_document WHERE kind='GUARDIAN' AND effective_from <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date ORDER BY effective_from DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_guardian d JOIN consent c ON c.document_id=d.id WHERE c.subject_user_id=#{userId} AND c.student_id=#{studentId} AND c.agreed AND c.status='AGREED' AND c.withdrawn_at IS NULL)
